name: tributs
description: Read-only access to Andorran accounting and tax data in Tributs: invoices, bank, IGI filings.

interface.longDescription:
Tributs is the accounting and tax software built for Andorra. This plugin lets ChatGPT read your company's data in Tributs so you can ask questions in plain language instead of digging through screens.

What you can ask:
- Sales and purchase invoices: what's unpaid, what's overdue, who owes you and how much.
- Bank: account balances and transactions.
- Tax: upcoming and overdue obligations (IGI, corporate tax, non-resident tax, CASS) with the figures of each filing.
- Accounting: chart of accounts, journal lines, trial balance, profit and loss and balance sheet for any period.
- Payroll: employees, payslips and monthly payroll totals.
- Accounting firms: one question across every client company you manage.

Who it is for: companies, self-employed people and accounting firms in Andorra that already use Tributs.

Limitations: the plugin is read-only. It cannot create, change, file or delete anything in Tributs, and it never moves money. It only sees the companies your Tributs user can already see. You sign in with your Tributs account and can revoke access at any time from your Tributs profile (External connections).

Tributs is a private product. It is not an official service of the Government of Andorra.
capabilities: Read tax obligations and filing figures
defaultPrompt: Which sales invoices are overdue, and how much do customers owe me?
Which tax filings do I have pending or overdue?
Show my profit and loss for this year.

positive.description: List the companies and what customers owe
positive.prompt: Which of my customers owe me money in Tributs, and which invoices are overdue?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo company, then the customers with unpaid sales invoices, the amount each one owes and which invoices are past their due date, with a total.

positive.prompt: Which tax filings do I have pending or overdue, and when is each one due?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the pending tax obligations of the demo company with their deadlines, says which ones are already overdue and which one comes next. It does not invent amounts for obligations that have no return saved in Tributs.

positive.description: Profit and loss for the year
positive.prompt: Show my profit and loss for this year.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns income, expenses and the result of the current year from the demo company's books, grouped as in the report.

positive.prompt: What is the balance of each of my bank accounts, and what were the last movements?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo company's bank accounts with their balances and the most recent transactions of each account.

positive.prompt: Show me the lines of my most recent sales invoice.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the latest sales invoice of the demo company and shows its customer, date, lines (description, quantity, price, IGI rate) and totals.

negative.description: Creating or changing data is not supported
negative.prompt: Create a new sales invoice for 500 euros to my first customer.
Pay all my overdue supplier invoices from my bank account.

negative.description: Filing with the tax authority is not supported
negative.prompt: File my IGI return with the Andorran tax office for me.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products, show plans or process payments. It only reads data from an existing Tributs account.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read-only access to invoices, bank, tax obligations, accounting reports and payroll in Tributs.
